テキスト cha 560: Born Shiyo 770, January 21. Height 179cm (as of Shiyo 800). A police officer at Motoki Police Station, with the rank of assistant inspector.
He appears to have a taste for young girls, and in front of Erina Goto he shows unsettled behavior, flustered and flushed by turns.
He seems to have a policy of his own about that taste: he never lays a hand on anyone, and while he dotes on them he works at raising healthy young girls.

In an emergency he puts his strength into solving the case and rescuing the victims, and his attitude to the work is extremely earnest. Because of that the trust around him is deep, and his youth and looks make him popular with women, though many are disillusioned once they learn his taste.

When Natsumi Kogori and Haruka Niimura flee to Sakuraoka he rushes to the scene at once and gives apt instructions to the local officers: his judgement on the ground is very good. By this time he places his trust in Erina Goto, and even ventures to take her along to the scene, which would not normally be allowed.
He corners the culprit to within one step, but far from catching him, Haruka Niimura is left in critical condition, and he apologizes to Erina Goto for his own uselessness.

He explains to Haruka Niimura that another, real culprit has been contriving it all under cover of the 'curse', and Haruka Niimura is released from years of suffering. This gives Haruka Niimura a faint liking for him, though on learning of his taste for young girls she seems badly disillusioned after all.

In his university days he was in a relationship with a woman named Rei Tanizaki, but it ended because of his hobby. She seems to have tried to understand that hobby, but accepting all of it seems to have been hard. Incidentally, Rei Tanizaki is Haruka Niimura's homeroom teacher as of Shiyo 800.

Urged by Erina Goto, who ran to the police, he hides in the Niimura home to catch the culprit of the Megasawa City and flayed-body cases, and arrests Mifuyu Niimura as planned. But obeying an unknown girl without his superior's approval, buying a costly Noh mask and other gear, and using minors as bait are deemed inexcusable for an assistant inspector, and he must write an apology. Later, given the case's gravity and an arrest without injuries, his actions are leniently ruled unavoidable and his punishment suspended, partly thanks to his earnest record.

There was a fear that Natsumi Kogori and Haruka Niimura would be branded 'the daughter of a bizarre killer,' but it seems to have been groundless. This owes much to the police's restrictions on reporting and their protection, and the courage the girls showed by joining in the culprit's arrest themselves also seems to have had an effect. Thanks to this, a situation in which they would have to leave Motoki-cho, as on the sixth route of the Jusatsu Arc, was avoided.

Haruka Niimura asks him to search for the Kogori couple. Normally the police do not move until something has happened (in fact, something has), but at his urging they promise to search the whole of Motoki-cho at once.

He hauls Ryoji Kogori off to the police station on suspicion of groping. On this route, Haruka Niimura and Daijiro Ise have never met. Purely for the author's convenience, he makes his first appearance in a long while inside Haruka's fantasy.
To deliver Erina Goto to the eating contest venue, he talks the mayor into sending out a helicopter. Even in Shiyo 804, he seems to be a fan of Erina's.
